Explanation: Name of the site - one of the six possible sites (LAK, TOM, BUB, KAK, DRO, EUC)
Sample originating form canopy or understory
Individual tree per species and strata, numbers 1 - 5
Code for the treatment, CN1 or CN2, always meaning Control treatment (this comes as a code from larger project where more treatments have been involved)
Factor indicating whether the data belong to one months long experiment or four months long experiment (1MO, 4MO)

Patrols are coded as A-B, C-D. A and C are beginnings of the season in each surveyed year. B and D are resampled leaves at the end of the season. Difference between B and A is the change in herbivory damage in that given year (ither after 1month or 4 months)
Coordinate indicating the Y position of that given leaf in scanned photo. Used only for summarization of the data and recornition of the leaves.
Coordinate indicating the X position of that given leaf in scanned photo. Used only for summarization of the data and recognition of the leaves.
Area.x - Area.y, i.e. actual leaf area eaten by insect herbivores.
Proportion of the leaf area eaten by herbivores, calculated as Herbivory/Area.x
Each tree individual had leaves sampled on three independent twigs, marked by coloured strings.
Latine name of the plan species used for analyses and phylogeny
Latine name of the plan species used for analyses and phylogeny - here in several cases, very close species were matched across canopy and understory as the given species did not occur in one strata
